description: Call this before creating a campaign to verify the tenant is ready to send email. Returns: sender domain(s) and their validation status, warm-up phase (cold/warming/warmed), daily send rate cap, and throttle settings. If the sending profile is not validated or still in warm-up, warn the user before scheduling a large campaign. Combine with nevent_get_suppressions_summary for a full deliverability health check.
name: nevent_get_sending_profile
